newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli troops in big manoeuvre on Golan Heights.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops in big manoeuvre on Golan Heights.

text.p: Israeli troops completed an exercise in the Golan Heights on Wednesday involving hundreds of soldiers from infantary, artillery, tank and air force units, the army and security sources said.

"The exercise is part of the annual training programme. It culminates a period of training for units...and improves their ability to fulfill routine and emergency assignments," an army spokesman said.
He said top army officers and Israeli leaders, including President Ezer Weizman, viewed the three-day manoeuvre.
Israel captured the Golan Heights from Syria in the 1967 Middle East war -- one of several fought between the two countries -- and deems the high-altitude plateau essential for its security.
Syria wants backs all of the Golan in exchange for peace. The two sides failed in five years of talks to reach an agreement.
Tension between the two countries soared last September when Syria moved thousands of its troops in Lebanon to within striking distance of the Golan Heights.
